Introducing GPT-Live, a new generation of voice models for natural human-AI interaction.

Rolling out in ChatGPT starting today.

GPT-Live makes talking with AI feel like having a real conversation. It’s also our smartest voice model yet.

It’s built on a full-duplex architecture, meaning it can listen and speak at the same time. This allows the model to engage in more natural back-and-forth, maintain a better sense of time, and even perform live translation.

Meet ChatGPT for Teens. It’s built to help teens learn outside the classroom with quizzes, Study Mode, and homework support, with stronger protections and parent tools from the start.

After his grandfather called asking to explain “the hype around AI,” 16-year-old Isa Ibrahim had an idea.

He knew his grandfather wasn’t alone in his curiosity, so he began teaching free AI literacy classes in libraries and senior residences around Chicago. His students use ChatGPT to plan trips, manage chores, and help them compose notes of gratitude for loved ones.

Now, some of those same students are vibe-coding their own AI-powered home repair and temperature-monitoring tools. For Isa, every success story feels like a meaningful step toward ensuring people of every generation can benefit
